shared_elements: schematic anthropomorphic head with flat/level top
straight continuous brow ridge in relief
narrow slit-like eyes beneath the brow
straight vertical nose merging with brow
narrow straight mouth rendered as a low relief bar/lips
frontal human figure carved in the round
justification: Both depict a frontal, highly schematic anthropomorphic figure whose face uses the same conventions: a flat-topped cranium, a single continuous straight brow ridge from which a broad nose descends, slit eyes tucked beneath it, and a thin straight mouth in low relief, with no ears or modelled cheeks — a specific and arbitrary combination rather than a generic face. The chief difference is that B additionally shows a torso with arms and incised body ornament (concentric circles, curved bands, a belt-like element) whereas A presents only the head and neck without any comparable surface motifs.
